projects.title: Campus Couture: Thematic Photoessay on Student Fashion
projects.description: This is a thematic photoessay I created in 2025. The thematic photoessay features three diverse university students’ fashion, exploring how each student uses clothing to express who they are.

projects.title: Sunflowers
projects.description: This is a photoshoot I captured and edited in August, 2026. The photoshoot prominently features sunflowers to encapsulate both creativity and youth.
